tex_content.html:
Definition
[Lipschitz hypothesis on the Hamiltonian] 1. ch10:10.2-def-2\group Viscosity Solutions \[ \begin{cases} |H(p,x) - H(q,x)| \leq C|p - q| \\ |H(p,x) - H(p,y)| \leq C|x - y|(1 + |p|) \end{cases} \tag {3} \] for $x, y, p, q \in \R ^n$ and some constant $C \geq 0$.
